findings.result: RUSI's official people page lists Dr Keith Ditcham as External Author / Former RUSI Senior Research Fellow (Organised Crime and Policing). Already recorded as the seed affiliation.
The Centre for Science and Policy (CSaP) at the University of Cambridge publicly lists Keith Ditcham in its policy network.

SHOC (Strategic Hub for Organised Crime Research, managed by RUSI's Organised Crime and Policing team) listed Keith Ditcham as SHOC Deputy Chair on its official About page; roster observed via search-index capture dated 2023-02-27 because the page is JS-rendered.
Search hits for other Keith Ditchams (detectorists club, education trusts) are different individuals and were excluded; no cross-dataset identity merge was made.

data.method: Repository search for existing records; Brave web search of official bios and directories; direct fetch of rusi.org, csap.cam.ac.uk, shoc.rusi.org; relation and org records created for each corroborated public listing; ambiguous common-name hits excluded.
